name: AtomStack A24 Ultra
tagline: Step-up A24 with more diode power and refined hybrid workflow
tldr: AtomStack A24 Ultra is the higher-tier A24 with more diode power and updated hybrid layout. Same use case as A24 Pro : metal marking plus organic work in a compact box : with more headroom for cutting.
mainObjective: Premium compact hybrid Atomstack for metal + wood shops

editorialDepth.advantages: AtomStack A24 Ultra 24W targets mixed engraving and wood-cutting weeks : fewer passes on basswood and dark acrylic than weaker SKUs in the same line.
editorialDepth.limitations: Wrong pick if you never engrave and only wanted the lowest price. Ultra-fine photo work can look better on an engraving-first SKU. Open-frame : safety and smoke are on you.
